blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY — A bomb threat disrupted the operation at the Hall of Justice here shortly after lunch on Wednesday. Members of the police bomb disposal unit immediately arrived and ordered all employees to vacate the building, as security guards prevented people from entering the premises. Employees said the Municipal Trial Court in Cities Branch 3 received the bomb threat and immediately reported the incident to the police. READ: Bomb threat disrupts Bulacan courts At 2:07 p.m., Executive Judge Richard Paradeza ordered employees who had gathered in front of the building to move at least 50 meters away.
